# ECO-VPP — Energy Community Virtual Power Plant

> ECO-VPP turns multi-unit residential buildings into a Virtual Power Plant using RED II Collective Self-Consumption, a GSY-e peer-to-peer energy market, and Energy Web settlement on a sub-€20 ESP32 node. A Horizon Europe project with pilots across Romania, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and Moldova.

## Pages

- [About — ECO-VPP](https://ecovpp.eu/about.html): The ECO-VPP project, its team, the Horizon Europe context, and the technology choices behind a sub-€20 Virtual Power Plant.
- [Contact — ECO-VPP](https://ecovpp.eu/contact.html): Get in touch with the ECO-VPP project team.
- [Live demo — ECO-VPP](https://ecovpp.eu/demo.html): Interactive ECO-VPP dashboard demo. Mocked data — wire to the real webhook-receiver via fetch().
- [Features — ECO-VPP](https://ecovpp.eu/features.html): Every component of the ECO-VPP platform: ingest, RED II sharing, VPP dispatch, settlement, forecasting, dashboard.
- [Price forecast — ECO-VPP](https://ecovpp.eu/forecast.html): Weather-driven 10-minute electricity price forecast. The <price-forecast> UI module, powered by Open-Meteo + the METOC Lagrangian nowcast.
- [ECO-VPP — Energy Community Virtual Power Plant](https://ecovpp.eu/): ECO-VPP turns multi-unit residential buildings into a Virtual Power Plant. RED II Collective Self-Consumption, GSY-e P2P market, Energy Web settlement on a sub-€20 ESP32 node.
- [Pilot sites — ECO-VPP](https://ecovpp.eu/pilots.html): ECO-VPP pilot deployments across Romania, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and Moldova.
